title: OmniMux plugin release tiers
description: The single source of truth for which plugins ship by default. Every consumer (preinstall bundles, market index, plugin repo lifecycle) reads this file instead of keeping its own list.

infrastructure.description: Always preinstalled and never marketable. These are the services every other plugin registers against (the sidebar), so removing one breaks the rest: it must not be expressible as an optional choice.

preview.description: Preinstalled in the shipped app and listed in the plugin market.

beta.description: Internal testing. Not preinstalled, not listed in the market; installable only by an explicit user action.

retired.description: No longer shipped. Kept only so a stale reference fails loudly instead of silently reappearing.
